title: Sewing Machine Deals UK: Machines, Parts & Servicing
description: Where to find genuine deals on sewing machines, parts and servicing in the UK: tested used machines, part exchange, PKSM’s eBay stock and smart buying tips.
h1: Deals on sewing machines, parts and servicing
intro: We don’t invent discounts. Instead, here are the honest routes to a better price on machines and parts, with current stock always listed by the seller.

image.alt: Old treadle sewing machine on a wooden stand

cardText: Tested used machines, part exchange, live stock listings and smart buying tips.

items.title: PKSM’s eBay store
items.text: Machines, parts and accessories from PK Sewing Machines, Leicester. Stock and prices change regularly.

items.title: Part exchange your old machine
items.text: Put the value of your current machine towards an upgrade.

items.title: Serviced used machines
items.text: A bench-tested used machine from a specialist can beat a budget new one.

items.title: Shows and open days
items.text: Craft shows such as Knit + Stitch often have exhibitor offers.

items.title: Buy consumables in packs
items.text: Needles and bobbins are usually cheaper per unit in multi-packs.

items.title: Know your rights
items.text: Buying from a business gives you more protection than a private sale.

sections.html:
• Compare the total cost: delivery, a service and any missing accessories.
  • A machine that needs a £50+ repair is not a bargain at a low price.
  • Check parts availability for the model before you buy.
  • Ask what testing, warranty or returns the seller offers.

sections.h2: Buying from a business vs a private seller
sections.html: In the UK, goods bought from a business must be of satisfactory quality, fit for purpose and as described under the Consumer Rights Act 2015. Private sales give you far fewer rights, so inspect and test carefully. Note that PKSM states its used machines are tested on its own bench before sale and sold as seen, so ask about the terms on any machine you are interested in.
